gelo — design system

One file, design/tokens.json, generates this page and everything it documents: a Hyprland shell, a login theme, a terminal, an editor theme, Spotify, GTK, a cursor and a Figma export. 37 colours, eleven targets, one source. If a token changes, this page changes with it or the build fails.

Reference is the PS3 XMB: cold silver-blue, one glowing accent, chrome surfaces, motion in a wave field behind the interface.

surfaces

ink

accent — three places, system-wide

Active workspace indicator, focused window border, and the cursor. Nowhere else. Selection, hover and urgency are carried by elevation, ink and opacity instead — a fourth accent location is a redesign, not a tweak.

wave field

Kept apart from the UI surfaces so the wallpaper can be more saturated than the chrome sitting on it.

terminal — ansi

Surfaces you work in are dark; chrome you work with is light. The editor and Spotify derive from this block, so an editor split and a terminal split are the same colour. ANSI 1/3/9/11 are genuinely red and yellow — load-bearing semantics, kept desaturated and cool-leaning.
